appDescription: Smart Journey tracks navigation destinations and manages restaurant waiting requests after explicit user approval.

function.name: GET_SMART_JOURNEY_STATUS
function.description: Get the current journey status and any pending question that needs a voice response.

function.name: RESPOND_SMART_JOURNEY_PROMPT
function.description: Apply the user's explicit approval or deferral to the pending Smart Journey question identified by its prompt ID.

promptId.description: The exact prompt ID returned with the current Smart Journey question.

decision.description: Whether the user explicitly approves the current request or prefers to defer it.
